rationale: This is the best available local transfer fixture with visibly different room-and-corridor context from accepted room_large.mp4.
It is a synthetic clip and was previously inspected as part of capture-gate inventory, so it is not a pristine unfamiliar holdout.
Its short camera path shows ceiling and wall discontinuities; this tests a bounded authored completion under visible source uncertainty.
No other local clip was found that is both sufficiently different and useful for an authored walkable room without new video generation.
corridor_travel.mp4 is familiar regression evidence and was not counted as a clean transfer fixture.

observations.claim: The initial view contains patterned wallpaper, carpet-like flooring, a tiled ceiling, square column faces, and a large open room with partitions.
Later views show a long straight hallway with repeated ceiling lights and wallpapered side walls.
A turn between the open room and hallway is visible in sampled viewpoints, but continuous navigable connectivity through the filmed camera path is not established.
Several sampled frames contain bright streaks or inconsistent geometry around ceiling lights, and the wallpaper/floor appearance shifts across the corridor views.
The observed column has multiple visible faces, but its hidden/back faces and exact solid footprint are occluded.
The exact room dimensions, metric scale, camera registration, and unseen spaces beyond the visible corridor are not established by this clip.

unknowns: The footage does not calibrate scene scale or camera-to-room registration.
The camera path and occlusions do not establish the complete floor plan, room count, or connectivity between the open room and later hallway views.
The far side and hidden faces of the visible column are unknown; the candidate uses an authored four-sided box proposal.
The true continuation beyond the visible hallway, all off-camera boundaries, and geometry behind the apparent corner remain unknown.
Ceiling streaks and changes in wallpaper/floor appearance are present in the synthetic source; whether they represent intended features or generation artifacts is unknown.
The candidate layout does not reconstruct camera poses or source perspective; source frame comparisons are context references, not registered view matches.

reusable_requirements.coordinate_convention: Godot local X/Y/Z with +Y up; design units only, no metric scale claim.
reusable_requirements.supported_footprint_representation: Finite simple orthogonal polygon in XZ; multiple floor regions require explicit unions.

player.safe_spawn_and_reset: Spawn in capsule-clear supported floor; R resets to that pose and clears velocity.

reusable_requirements.floor_and_ceiling: Record floor elevation, ceiling envelope, supported route and clearance separately; floor support must remain continuous over traversal.
reusable_requirements.collision_policy: Keep floor, closed room boundaries and obstacle collision authored and tested separately from visual meshes.
reusable_requirements.render_placement_policy: Record a conservative envelope for every visible room mesh and background mesh; rendered placement does not imply walkable support.
reusable_requirements.socket_policy: Distinguish observed source openings, authored sockets and tested connectors. Close unused perimeter edges. A candidate with no tested connector makes no stitchability claim.
additional_constraints: Keep geometry origin, texture origin, placement assumptions and collision origin as independent provenance fields.
Source-derived crops may provide appearance for explicitly authored geometry.
Use existing Godot 4.6.3 controller and frozen material/PSX contract v1.0.0.

walkable_space.coordinate_system: Local Godot X/Z, +Y up; uncalibrated design units.

measurement.method: 10 cm capsule grid, 2 cm floor clearance, floor rays, 4-neighbor connectivity

boundary_and_obstacle_collision.collision_origin: Separate Godot StaticBody3D floor, perimeter and obstacle colliders; the authored west socket uses matching return/header visuals and collision.
boundary_and_obstacle_collision.exposed_boundary_policy: The west edge is open only in the provisional connection scene. All other edges stay closed. The standalone scene restores the original full west wall; runtime tests probe every closed corridor edge.

rendered_placement_envelope.containment_method: Every MeshInstance3D local AABB corner transformed to world coordinates and checked against the declared conservative AABB; zero escaped meshes across 16 meshes.

surfaces.geometry_origin: Manually authored orthogonal wall geometry; dimensions and L layout are design proposals.
surfaces.appearance_origin: Direct 410x260 source pixel crop from frame_0001 at xyxy [100,390,510,650]; nearest-neighbor unshaded material, no resize/color edit.
surfaces.placement_basis: Approximate room and corridor composition selected to test a bounded L-turn; not a camera-registered source placement.
surfaces.collision_origin: Separate authored perimeter wall StaticBody3D shapes.

surfaces.geometry_origin: Two authored rectangular floor slabs forming a continuous L-shaped union.
surfaces.appearance_origin: Direct 400x215 source pixel crop from frame_0001 at xyxy [120,820,520,1035]; no resize/color edit.
surfaces.placement_basis: Layout follows a candidate walkable polygon, not recovered source geometry.
surfaces.collision_origin: Separate authored WalkableFloor body with two collision boxes.

surfaces.geometry_origin: Two authored rectangular ceiling planes matching the L-shaped visual floor footprint.
surfaces.appearance_origin: Direct 420x220 source pixel crop from frame_0001 at xyxy [100,0,520,220]; no resize/color edit.
surfaces.placement_basis: 3 design-unit ceiling height selected for playable headroom; not measured from footage.

surfaces.geometry_origin: One authored 0.9x3.0x0.9 box around the observed column location; complete hidden faces are a design completion.
surfaces.appearance_origin: Direct 155x420 source pixel crop from frame_0001 at xyxy [555,300,710,720]; no resize/color edit.
surfaces.placement_basis: Placed in the first room leg as an authored obstacle; source pixels do not establish its footprint or exact pose.
surfaces.collision_origin: Separate authored full-height box collider matching visible bounds.

surfaces.appearance_origin: Solid pale material consistent with the source light panels; no source crop applied to emissive lights.
surfaces.placement_basis: Regular spacing along both legs for visual continuity; positions are manual design choices.

sockets.closure_behavior: Source-visible gap remains a video observation only; it does not establish the authored game connection.
Open in the four-room comparison adapter only; capped in the standalone module. Unused corridor edges remain closed.

manual_decisions: Author an east/west doorway pair on the unregistered west shell edge; footage does not prove a connection here.
Reuse the accepted #164 room arrangement as the regression prefix and add the #165 corridor as a fourth distinct room.
Keep all unused #165 perimeter edges closed and retain an independent closed standalone variant.
authoring_log.effort: One versioned room adapter, one receiver adapter, a four-room layout, and bounded runtime verification; no source video, inference, or retraining.

notes: Godot route, floor support, closed perimeters, approach clearance and negative controls are recorded.
Guarded 1280x720 captures completed after the operator closed the active graphics client.
Both connection directions and the capture camera poses are recorded; captures are supplemental evidence for the exact reviewed candidate.
Uncapped frame profile: 34 poses and 10,199 frames; average 239.86 FPS, p95 4.287 ms, p99 4.403 ms.
Guard receipt records 48.749 s elapsed, peak child RSS 2,425,692,160 bytes, and peak GPU-memory delta 583,008,256 bytes.

operator_decision.scope: Accepts this exact seed-166 four-room layout and authored R002.west_back to R003.west connection. Does not admit either candidate module to the shared catalog, approve metric scale or source registration, establish source-video connectivity, or generalize the connector.
